lanePlan.deliverable: Inventory of every call site of the legacy parser entry point.
lanePlan.acceptance: Every reported call site resolves to an existing path and line, and the reported count equals a rerun of the recorded search command.

lanePlan.deliverable: Scoped summary of the behaviors the replacement parser must preserve.
lanePlan.acceptance: Every preserved behavior cites a path and line or a stored command output, and assumptions are listed separately.

lanePlan.deliverable: Interface contract for the replacement parser plus the exact call-site edit to apply.
lanePlan.acceptance: The contract names every preserved behavior from the constraints lane and the call-site edit is stated precisely enough to apply without further judgement.

lanePlan.deliverable: The specified call-site edit applied to every match in src/parser/callers.ts.
lanePlan.acceptance: The before-count and after-count of edited call sites agree and no file outside src/parser/callers.ts is modified.

lanePlan.deliverable: The replacement parser implemented against the contract, preceded by a failing test.
lanePlan.acceptance: A stored failing test output predates the implementation, a stored passing output follows it, and the diff is confined to src/parser/.

lanePlan.deliverable: Stored raw output of the full test suite and of the parser-specific tests.
lanePlan.acceptance: Each stored artifact carries its exact command line and exit code, and the parser tests are shown to have been collected and run.

lanePlan.deliverable: Findings against the replacement parser, each with a reachable precondition.
lanePlan.acceptance: Every finding names an input or sequence that reaches it and points at stored evidence; speculation is listed separately.

lanePlan.deliverable: One recorded verdict with its rationale and the unresolved critical and high count.
lanePlan.acceptance: The verdict cites the post-integration gate output and is not approve while any critical or high finding is unresolved without a recorded human exception.
